title: NIST PQC standards (FIPS 203/204/205)
description: Documented public post-quantum standards (NIST) for the Post-Quantum Cryptography Planner capability area.
body:
NIST PQC standards (FIPS 203/204/205) is a documented post-quantum standards from NIST. NIST's 2024 post-quantum standards: ML-KEM (Kyber) for key establishment, ML-DSA (Dilithium) and SLH-DSA (SPHINCS+) for signatures.

How it works: It works by tabulating the standardized public-key, ciphertext, and signature sizes from NIST FIPS 203/204/205 for direct comparison.
